direction: (~16 s) Wide closing still at dusk. The monk and the woman walk toward the small thatched church, where a faint light shows in the doorway. The new mound joins the rows on the hill, and the Ely marshes lie dim and silver below. Slow pull-back. Ambience: psalm chant rising from the church, wind, a last curlew.

still.prompt: Photoreal 16:9 wide shot at dusk, early medieval Wales c. 650 AD. Two small figures, a tonsured monk in an undyed habit and a cloaked woman, walk across an inland hilltop cemetery of low turf mounds toward a small thatched timber church with a faint warm glow in its doorway. Far below, river marshes and a distant tidal estuary catch the last silver light. No beach, no cliffs, no stone ruins, no text, no heraldry.

captions.text: St Dochdwy's church, beside the later farm, stands where archaeology places an early monastery (CH-0001)
